slides.title: The case for Mintlify
slides.lead: Today, every prospect meets a person before they meet the product. This paper makes the case for changing that.

cards.title: The problem
cards.desc: Manual, Back Office and Sales-led enablement for every proof of value.

cards.title: The proposal
cards.desc: Adopt Mintlify as a self-service distribution site, in the model of PLAID.

cards.title: The ask
cards.desc: Approve an investigation spike before formal contracting.

slides.title: Where enablement happens today
slides.lead: Every prospect and customer question currently routes through a person, with no self-service path.

left.label: What we have
items: Intercom Help Center for in-product articles
Sales walks every prospect through a live demo
Support and Customer Success run manual POV setup

right.label: Why it doesn't scale
items: No sandbox — every evaluation needs a booked call
Contracting conversations start before value is proven
Back Office time is spent on repeat manual walkthroughs
Sales cycle length is tied to internal calendar availability

slides.title: Prospects arrive warm, not cold
slides.lead: The goal: a visitor tries Omnisient on sample data, sees the value, and only then starts a commercial conversation.

cards.title: Try before they buy
cards.desc: Self-service access to a working sample of the platform, no meeting required.

cards.title: Warm, not cold
cards.desc: Sales engages once a prospect has already seen value on their own time.

cards.title: Contracting comes last
cards.desc: Commercial conversations start after proof, not instead of it.

blocks.text: US strategy already names the target: a self-service distribution site, in the model of PLAID.

slides.title: What we need from a tool
slides.lead: The right platform needs to do six things well, from public docs to CRM hand-off.

cards.title: Public + protected docs
cards.desc: Free-to-browse pages, gated content behind login.

cards.title: Self-service sandbox path
cards.desc: A working example a prospect can try alone.

cards.title: Agent-readable access
cards.desc: The same content works for a human and for Claude Code.

cards.title: Docs-as-code workflow
cards.desc: Git-backed authoring, previews, and review.

cards.title: Region-aware delivery
cards.desc: Right content for the right market, one source.

cards.title: Sales & CRM hand-off
cards.desc: Curated milestones flow to Salesforce, not raw data.

slides.title: Mintlify vs. Intercom, and the rest of the field
slides.lead: Intercom is the incumbent for support. It was never built as a self-service front door.

left.label: Mintlify — proposed
items: Authenticated MCP for AI agent access

right.label: Intercom — retained, narrowed
items: Built for support, not self-service onboarding
Priced per seat, plus $0.99 per Fin AI resolution

blocks.text: Also in the field: GitBook (best all-round alternative), ReadMe (API telemetry), Redocly/Scalar (API-design-first), Docusaurus (free, self-hosted). None matched Mintlify's combined score in the earlier platform review.

cards.title: License cost
cards.desc: Pro: $450/mo (~R7,320), unlimited seats. Enterprise (adds SSO/SCIM/RBAC): custom quote required.

cards.title: Contracting approach
cards.desc: Pro is self-serve, card-based. Enterprise is sales-led with a custom agreement.

cards.title: Trial availability
cards.desc: Starter tier is free indefinitely — usable now for an internal spike. No dedicated Enterprise trial.

cards.title: Application across the business
cards.desc: One platform for public docs, protected developer content, and the self-service sandbox front door.

cards.title: ZAR / USD
cards.desc: Pro ≈ R7,320/mo at the Aug 2026 average rate (R16.26/USD). Enterprise pricing not yet known.

cards.title: Vanta listing
cards.desc: Not listed on Vanta. Mintlify's trust center runs on SafeBase/Drata (security.mintlify.com) — InfoSec review routes there instead.

blocks.text: Mintlify disclosed and remediated a security incident earlier in 2026 — InfoSec should review the postmortem before sign-off.

slides.title: Recommendation and next steps
slides.lead: Mintlify is the strongest fit for a self-service front door, at a fraction of what a custom build would cost.

cards.title: Build vs. buy
cards.desc: A custom sandbox and docs portal would cost engineering months Mintlify replaces for $450/mo.

cards.title: Proven at scale
cards.desc: Anthropic's Claude docs and Lovable both run on Mintlify today — real, verifiable customers, not a reference call.

blocks.text: Recommended: approve a scoped investigation spike into Mintlify before any formal contracting.
